name: St Regis Residence Club, Aspen
positioning: Residence club of two- and three-bedroom residences in the heart of Aspen, a few steps from the base of Aspen Mountain, with use of The St. Regis Aspen Resort's pool and RAKxa Wellness Spa
best_for: Skiers who want to be a few steps from the base of Aspen Mountain
Families or groups wanting multi-bedroom residences within walking distance of downtown Aspen

facts.text: The residences are in the heart of Aspen, within walking distance of the town's main attractions, including boutiques and restaurants.
Two-bedroom residences have one king bed in the first bedroom, two twin beds in the second and a sofa bed.
Several residence types sleep up to eight guests.
Residences have a coffee and tea maker.
The fitness center has Technogym equipment.
The concierge service helps guests plan their activities.
The Snow Lodge is a wintertime entertainment concept from the team behind The Surf Lodge in Montauk.
The Velvet Buck uses local, seasonal ingredients in a fusion of multiple cuisines.
Aspen-Pitkin County Airport is approximately 3.0 miles from the property.

highlights.text: The St. Regis Residence Club is a few steps from the base of Aspen Mountain.
Three-bedroom residences have a king bed in each of the three bedrooms.
Guests can use the resort's outdoor heated pool and hot tub, open all year long.
Guests can use RAKxa Wellness Spa, which is located within The St. Regis Aspen Resort.
Mountain Social Bar & Lounge holds a daily champagne sabering and serves a signature St. Regis Bloody Mary.

considerations.text: The residences do not have a work space.
The minimum age to check in is 21.
Breakfast is available onsite at The Velvet Buck for a fee.
